definitions.explanation: The process of returning something to a normal or proper state. Commonly used in diplomacy (normalizing relations), economics (normalizing policy), and general contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧{正常化|せいじょうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The normalization of relations between the two countries progressed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正常化|せいじょうか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧。
examples.english: We will make efforts toward normalizing the situation.

examples.japanese: ストライキ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わり、⟦{運行|うんこう}→運行：14375_unkou⟧⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{正常化|せいじょうか}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The strike ended and the train schedule was restored to normal.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{正常|せいじょう}→正常：03085_seijou⟧ (normal, proper) and ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (-ization suffix). A formal word frequently used in news and official contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正常化|せいじょうか}: normalization of relations
- ⟦{国交|こっこう}→国交：12015_kokkou⟧{正常化|せいじょうか}: normalization of diplomatic relations
- ⟦{金融|きんゆう}{政策|せいさく}→金融政策：18097_kinyuuseisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正常化|せいじょうか}: normalization of monetary policy
- ⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正常化|せいじょうか}: normalization of the situation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧: recovery — returning to a previous good state
- {安定化|あんていか}: stabilization — becoming stable
- ⟦{正常|せいじょう}→正常：03085_seijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return to normal — more conversational expression
